annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I hate being rushed into choosing between people and the one thing
annotations.pda_responsibility: The train keeps going because I let it.
I'll have been the one who decided it.
it's partly because I chose not to act

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: Both land on me, and I can't pick instantly.

annotations.pda_responsibility: Knowing that makes me answerable either way.

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I don't want to be the person choosing.

annotations.pda_responsibility: If I leave the train alone, that's me choosing too.
I'm the reason the train goes one way or the other.
stalling too long becomes its own answer, one I'd own
